title: Skill
description: A Skill is procedural crystal frontmatter. Verified, executable, reusable skills admitted into the Procedural layer via the verifier-gated path (MISSION.md §Procedural + FORGE D5, G3).

capability_class.description: High-level capability class. Hook for polyglot skill abstraction (deferred to v0.2, MISSION.md §Out of scope).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this skill does.

language.description: Primary language of the skill's verifier script.

inputs.description: Typed parameter list consumed by the verifier.

verifier.description: Path to the executable test / verifier script (relative to the skill blob root). Must pass (exit 0) for procedural admission (G3).

provenance.description: Provenance of the skill (same shape as Crystal.provenance).

trust_tier.description: Trust tier. Must be >= T1 (T0 or T1) for shared skills (MISSION.md §Procedural admission requires verifier-gated).

success_count.description: Number of times this skill has been successfully invoked.

last_used.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of most recent successful invocation. null = never used.

activation_conditions.description: Optional structured conditions under which this skill is activated (hook for v0.2 capability dispatch).
